game: KC@SEA Week 7 / kickoff not in pack / SEA -3 / total 43 / weather not saved

script.base: SEA -3 at a 43 total implies a one-score home lead (implied totals SEA 23, KC 20), not a shootout. Wilson keeps the bellcow run role (~18 carries, 3.53 YPC in weeks 4-6) as SEA leans run to hold a late lead; KC still feeds Walker volume, but SEA's 3.65 YPC allowed and only 8 passes of 20+ on 197 attempts cap explosives. Pace stays moderate and garbage time is not the base.
script.flip1: SEA jumps up two scores early, KC abandons the run (Walker carries and his 6.36 YPC spike die; Worthy 158 air and Thornton 160 air become the path), and Wilson's carry count rises as SEA clocks it — the Wilson rush over gets safer.
script.flip2: KC scores first and leads, SEA trails, and Darnold drops back more (JSN's 30 targets / 312 yards path expands). Wilson falls toward 12-14 carries and the 51.5 rush over dies; a true shootout is the less likely version of this flip because SEA has allowed only 8 explosive passes in 6 games.

matchup.shell: No MOFO/MOFC or man/zone charting in the pack. Location only: SEA allows left 5.38 YPA (71 att), middle 6.10 (30), right 4.76 (79) — no true bleed, middle least-bad. KC allows left 6.57 (60), middle 8.15 (52), right 4.38 (69) — middle is the only soft spot.
matchup.pressure: SEA blitzes 21%, so Mahomes' blitz edge (0.34 EPA/dropback, n=48, vs 0.12 unblitzed) mostly stays unused. KC blitzes 27%; Darnold is flat vs blitz (0.03 EPA, n=81, vs 0.05 unblitzed), so pressure does not project a checkdown explosion or a deep-yard collapse.
matchup.bleeds: SEA run D 3.65 YPC with 13 runs of 10+ in 6 games and only 8 explosive passes. KC run D 3.56 YPC with 11 runs of 10+ in 5 games and 12 explosive passes on 190 attempts. KC middle at 8.15 YPA is the passing soft spot; SEA does not bleed by location or by explosive rate.
matchup.overlap: The clean overlap is volume, not a weak run front: Wilson's 3.53 YPC already matches KC's 3.56 allowed, so 51.5 is low versus an 18-carry role, not an efficiency bet. JSN (30 tgt, 312 yds, 348 air) is the receiver who can attack KC's middle, but 93.5 is +nan and is not a leg. KC's deep duo Worthy (158 air / 163 yds) and Thornton (160 air / 133 yds) runs into a SEA defense with 8 explosives on 197 attempts — poor overlap, and those lines are unpriced.

form: Avoid the season averages; L3 only. Wilson 55/194 over weeks 4-6 is stable volume (18.3 carries, 3.53 YPC, ~65 rush yds/game), not a one-play spike, plus 7 targets / 50 yards. Walker 59/375 (6.36 YPC, 125 rush yds/game) over weeks 3/4/6 is the efficiency that will not repeat against 3.65 YPC and only 13 chunk runs; his 80.5 line already prices that, and one 30-yarder still clears it, so no Walker leg. Johnson 9/23 and absent from the target list. JSN 104 rec yds/game is the form standout but unpriced. Shaheed 16/109/236 is 6.8 YPT on 14.8 air/target — spike-dependent, pass. Royals 7/35, Horton 6/19, Barner 12/48, Holani 16/45 at 2.81 YPC lack margin.

edge_players.edge_sentence: Wilson is the SEA bellcow at 55 carries and 194 yards over his last three (~65 a game, 3.53 YPC), KC allows 3.56 YPC so they do not suppress him, and 51.5 sits about 13 yards under that matchup-neutral number in a SEA -3 script that should protect his carries.
edge_players.must_be_true: Wilson stays the lead back near 15+ carries (breakeven is about 14.5 carries at 3.53-3.56 YPC), SEA does not trail early and shelve the run, and he is not on a snap limit — health is assumed only because the pack lists him as the 55-carry back with no injury note.
edge_players.kills_it: KC leads and SEA abandons the run: 12 carries at 3.3 YPC is about 40 yards and the under wins. A Holani/Jones series steal that cuts him under 14 carries does the same.

data_check.notes: No projection, sim median, or Pinnacle no-vig in the pack, so step 8 cannot be run numerically and no model probability is claimed. Available data agrees: 194 rush yards / 3 games (~65) vs 51.5, and KC's 3.56 YPC allowed does not haircut his 3.53. Listed price is -114 / -114, a pick'em, so the edge is the line level not the juice. Do not read this as a 70%+ leg. Walker under 80.5 was the disagree case (125 recent vs the line) and was dropped on pre-mortem, not flagged, because the counter-case was stronger. Timestamp not in the pack.

pre_mortem: It's Monday and Wilson under 51.5 lost: KC led by 10 at half, SEA went pass-heavy, and Wilson finished 12 carries for 38 while JSN and Shaheed soaked the script. That trailing flip is live because SEA is only -3, not a two-score chalk. Separate drops: Johnson rushrec under 18.5 looks fat versus 9/23 and zero targets, but one chunk run — SEA has allowed 13 runs of 10+ in 6 games — clears 18.5 on a 4-carry day, so the counter-case is stronger. Holani rush over 9.5 has only a 5-yard cushion at 2.81 YPC. Walker under 80.5 loses to the same explosive profile (6.36 YPC) that inflated his 375 yards.
slip_story: One-story slip for the base SEA -3 grind, not a shootout and not a blowout: Wilson rush over as the favorite-bellcow volume anchor. Do not add JSN/Worthy/Shaheed overs, a game over, or Walker rush over — those need the pass-heavy or explosive flip. Johnson and Holani adds were considered and dropped. No TDs, one market on Wilson, single leg.
